Report Title: GPT-5.5 Biosecurity Evaluation (SecureBio with CAISI oversight)
Finding: GPT-5.5 (Checkpoint 2) showed comparable usability to GPT-5.4 on the BioTIER refusal benchmark but LOWER safety than GPT-5.4 -- i.e., a safeguard regression relative to its predecessor on bio-weaponization refusals.
Company Response: OpenAI's GPT-5.5 System Card (Deployment Safety Hub) publishes SecureBio's external bio-capabilities evaluation and states that system-level biological-risk content filters were disabled for the duration of the assessment, that SecureBio did not systematically assess robustness of the mitigations to jailbreaking, and that the evaluated checkpoints differ from the deployed model so SecureBio plans to rerun on the deployed model and report differences. No concrete fix tied to the refusal/safety regression is stated.
